payload.name: Follow-up location search for activity events
payload.description: When answering a 'where did [person] [discover/do] [thing]?' question and the most relevant memory names the activity but not its location.
content: Before answering a location question, inspect the evidence memory for an explicit location. If the directly relevant memory (e.g., discovering a dive spot) has no place, run one additional search combining the person, a time window around that memory's date, and location terms such as trip, traveled, visited, retreat, city, or country.

Prefer the memory that explicitly mentions the activity asked about; do not answer with a thematically similar memory (like a waterfall or beach) unless it also mentions that activity. Stop once a location-bearing memory from the same time window is found.

solves: When the best activity memory lacks its location, the agent answers from a thematically similar but unrelated memory instead of searching for a second memory that places the person at a place in the same time window. Applies to 'Where did [person] find/do [thing]?' when the activity memory omits location. Not for memories that already state a location or for general preference questions.
